player_prompt.intro:
Oe o le Taaloga {player_id} i le **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Faaulufale mai lau gaoioiga e pei o **[macro  micro]** (lua numera 0-8):
• *macro*  = le laupapa laiti e te taalo ai
• *micro* = le faamalu o le laupapa laiti lena
Faataitaiga `[7 8]` ➜ tuu lau faailoga i le laupapa laiti 7, faamalu 8, ma
faamalosi lou fili e taalo i le laupapa laiti 8 e sosoo ai.

Oe o `{symbol}`.

board.current_board: Komiti Faatino o loʻo iai nei: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: E tatau ona faia le fesuiaiga i se pepa [macro micro] ma fuainumera 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O faasino taʻitasi e tatau ona i le va o le 0 ma le 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: O le micro_board, laina, po o col ua i fafo atu o tulaga.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Ua uma ona nofoia le potu.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: E tatau ona taaalo le tagata taʻaʻalo i le isi laupapa laitiiti.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Ua uma ona manumalo le laupapa o loo iai nei.

game_action.played: O le tagata taʻalo {player_id} na taʻalo i luga o le papa laiti {macro_idx}, selo {micro_idx} (lili {row}, kolasi {col}). O le a tatou toe taʻalo ai le tagata taʻalo {opponent_id} i totonu o {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: O le tagata taalo {player_id} e manumalo i le Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
